descripcion: Playground with moving equipment, outdoor gym, dog park, picnic area, trails, water, trees and hedges, garden, vegetable plot and beach.

columpio_doble.descripcion: Frame with two seats hanging on chains. The legs splay at each end; the seats swing hard to the front and back. You hear it creak: never cross its path, go round one end.
columpio_doble.imagen: Footprint of “Double swing”: an H on its side: splayed legs at each end and the beam with the seats in between, 3.20 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

zona_vaiven_columpio.descripcion: Strip of soft ground in front of and behind the swing: this is where the seats travel. Standing on it you may be hit; step off and go round by the legs.
zona_vaiven_columpio.aviso: Swing zone: you may be hit here. Step out and go round.
zona_vaiven_columpio.imagen: Footprint of “Swing clearance zone”: a rectangle, 3.50 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “Zv”.

columpio_nido.descripcion: Frame with a round rope basket, as big as a small table, hung on four chains. It is heavy and sweeps a wide path; several children can lie in it.
columpio_nido.imagen: Footprint of “Basket swing”: an H on its side: splayed legs at each end and the beam with the seats in between, 3.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cn”.

columpio_bebe.descripcion: Small single frame with an enclosed cradle seat and a front bar. The seat is at an adult's hip height and swings gently.
columpio_bebe.imagen: Footprint of “Baby swing”: an H on its side: splayed legs at each end and the beam with the seats in between, 1.90 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

columpio_adaptado.descripcion: Sheet-metal platform hung from a tall frame, with a fold-down ramp at the front for the wheelchair. At rest the ramp touches the ground; in use the whole platform swings.
columpio_adaptado.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelchair swing”: a rectangle, 2.60 by 3.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

tobogan_parque.descripcion: Free-standing slide: a steep ladder with handrails at the back, a small platform on top and the smooth chute to the front, ending almost at ground level. Children shoot out of the exit: do not stand in front of it.
tobogan_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Playground slide with ladder”: a long strip with a bulge: the ladder at the back, the wider platform and the chute to the front, 1.10 by 3.80 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

tobogan_tubo.descripcion: Tower with a closed plastic tube curving down. It sounds hollow when struck and you hear children sliding inside. The exit mouth is at the front, at knee height.
tobogan_tubo.imagen: Footprint of “Tube slide”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 2.50 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

torre_multijuego.descripcion: Two roofed timber towers joined by a wobbly hanging bridge. Under the platforms the space is at adult head height: duck if you go in.
torre_multijuego.imagen: Footprint of “Multi-play tower with bridge”: two square towers joined by a narrower bridge, 5.50 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

red_piramidal.descripcion: Very tall central mast with taut ropes running down to four ground anchors, forming a net pyramid. The low ropes are thin and the cane may slip between them.
red_piramidal.imagen: Footprint of “Pyramid climbing net”: a 4-pointed star, 4.50 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

rocodromo_infantil.descripcion: Low wavy wall with resin holds sticking out like fists. You can trail it with your hand, but mind the holds at face height.
rocodromo_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Children's climbing wall”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ri”.

barras_mono.descripcion: Horizontal ladder of rungs at adult head height, on four corner posts. The cane passes underneath without touching it: you hit it with your forehead.
barras_mono.imagen: Footprint of “Monkey bars”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 2.50 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bm”.

barra_equilibrio_parque.descripcion: Low V-shaped log, a hand's width off the ground, to walk along. Your hand will not find it: it is a trip hazard at shin height.
barra_equilibrio_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Zigzag balance beam”: an open V, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

casita_parque.descripcion: Child-sized wooden hut with a doorway and glassless windows. The roof eaves are at an adult's chest height.
casita_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Playground playhouse”: a house-shaped pentagon, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

tirolina_cable.descripcion: Taut cable between two distant posts, with a seat hanging from a pulley. Cable and seat cross at head and chest height, and at speed: the cane gives no warning. You hear the pulley whirr.
tirolina_cable.imagen: Footprint of “Zip line cable with seat”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 12.00 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tc”.

tirolina_plataforma.descripcion: Wooden ramp rising to knee height at the foot of the zip line post. Children launch from here, always in the same direction.
tirolina_plataforma.imagen: Footprint of “Zip line launch platform”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

balancin_doble.descripcion: Long beam tilting on a central pivot, with a seat and a handle at each end. One end is on the ground and the other at chest height; they swap suddenly.
balancin_doble.imagen: Footprint of “Two-seat seesaw”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bd”.

balancin_muelle.descripcion: Plastic figure (a pony, a motorbike) on a thick spring anchored to the ground. Push it and it nods and springs back; handles and footrests stick out.
balancin_muelle.imagen: Footprint of “Spring rocker”: an oval, 0.40 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

carrusel_suelo.descripcion: Round ground-level platform with grab bars that spins when pushed. When turning, the bars sweep past at hip height and can hit you; you hear the bearing.
carrusel_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Ground roundabout”: a circle, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

cama_elastica_suelo.descripcion: Bouncy mat flush with the ground, framed in rubber. It does not block the way, but the ground gives and springs back underfoot: it throws you off balance.
cama_elastica_suelo.aviso: Trampoline: the ground gives and bounces.
cama_elastica_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “In-ground trampoline”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

mesa_agua_infantil.descripcion: Steel channels at a child's waist height, with a hand pump, sluices and water wheels. The ground around is wet and slippery.
mesa_agua_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Water play table”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

panel_sensorial.descripcion: Upright board between two posts, with spinning wheels, sliding beads, textures and a raised maze to trace with a finger.
panel_sensorial.imagen: Footprint of “Sensory play panel”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

panel_musical_tubos.descripcion: Row of metal tubes of different lengths hung in a frame, with a mallet on a cord. Strike them and they ring like bells, low to high.
panel_musical_tubos.imagen: Footprint of “Tubular chimes panel”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

tubos_parlantes.descripcion: Post with a funnel at a child's face height. A buried pipe links it to a twin several metres away: speak into one and you are heard at the other.
tubos_parlantes.imagen: Footprint of “Talking tube”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

arenero_parque.descripcion: Pit of fine sand ringed by a wooden kerb a hand's width high. It does not block the way: step over the kerb and your feet sink in.
arenero_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Park sandpit with kerb”: a hexagon, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

suelo_caucho.descripcion: Soft rubber surfacing under the play equipment. It does not block the way: steps sound muffled and the foot sinks slightly. Where the rubber starts, the play area starts.
suelo_caucho.imagen: Footprint of “Rubber safety surfacing”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

vallado_infantil.descripcion: Hip-high slatted fence enclosing the play area. Follow it with your hand or cane until you reach the gate.
vallado_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Low playground fence”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Vi”.

puerta_muelle_infantil.descripcion: Metal gate in the fence, with the latch on top, out of children's reach. It is sprung: it shuts by itself behind you with a bang.
puerta_muelle_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Self-closing playground gate”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

banco_vigilancia.descripcion: Long slatted bench curved to face the play equipment, where carers sit. A good meeting point: you can hear the whole enclosure from it.
banco_vigilancia.imagen: Footprint of “Curved playground watch bench”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.50 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

bio_rueda_hombros.descripcion: Post with a large wheel on each side at shoulder height, turned by hand. The wheels stick out from the post: the cane finds the post, your shoulder finds the wheel.
bio_rueda_hombros.imagen: Footprint of “Shoulder wheel”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

bio_pedales.descripcion: Metal bench with a backrest and, in front, pedals fixed to the ground to work your legs while seated. The pedals are at shin level.
bio_pedales.imagen: Footprint of “Pedal bench”: a T shape, 0.60 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

bio_esqui.descripcion: Machine with two foot plates and two long poles: everything swings back and forth. When in use, the poles sweep to the front and back.
bio_esqui.imagen: Footprint of “Cross-country skier”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

bio_volante.descripcion: Central post with two wheels, one flat and one upright, at chest height. They spin freely when touched.
bio_volante.imagen: Footprint of “Tai chi wheels”: a circle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

bio_cintura.descripcion: Post with three handles and, on the ground, three round plates that swivel underfoot. The plates stand a hand's width proud: a trip hazard, and they slip if you step on without holding.
bio_cintura.imagen: Footprint of “Three-station waist twister”: a triangle pointing to the front, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bio_paralelas.descripcion: Two long parallel metal bars at hip height, to walk between while leaning on your hands. You enter at the ends; from the sides they block the way.
bio_paralelas.imagen: Footprint of “Low parallel bars”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

bio_escalera_rampa.descripcion: Three steps up, a landing and a ramp down, with handrails on both sides. For practising stairs; it sounds like hollow sheet metal underfoot.
bio_escalera_rampa.imagen: Footprint of “Exercise steps and ramp”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

vallado_canino.descripcion: Wire mesh chest high or taller, stretched between posts. It rattles when struck; dogs run loose on the other side.
vallado_canino.imagen: Footprint of “Dog park fence”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Vc”.

esclusa_canina.descripcion: Entrance cage with two gates in a row: open the first, shut it, then the second, so no dog escapes. There is room inside for one person and a dog.
esclusa_canina.imagen: Footprint of “Dog park double gate”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

fuente_perros.descripcion: Push-button fountain with a metal bowl at ground level for dogs. There is always a puddle around it.
fuente_perros.imagen: Footprint of “Fountain with dog bowl”: a narrow pillar at the back (with the spout) and a wide trough at the front, 0.40 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Fp”.

agility_rampa.descripcion: Two wide boards leaning together like a roof, with slats for the dog to climb up and down. The ridge is above head height.
agility_rampa.imagen: Footprint of “Agility A-frame”: a rectangle, 0.95 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

agility_tunel.descripcion: Hooped canvas tube curved on the ground for dogs to run through. It is soft and gives when touched; a dog may shoot out of either mouth.
agility_tunel.imagen: Footprint of “Agility tunnel”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.50 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

agility_slalom.descripcion: Twelve thin plastic poles in a straight line, two hands apart, up to hip height. They are so thin the cane may pass between two without touching.
agility_slalom.imagen: Footprint of “Agility weave poles”: a rectangle, 0.06 by 6.60 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

agility_aro.descripcion: Large hoop hung inside a frame at knee height for the dog to jump through. The frame's feet spread across the ground.
agility_aro.imagen: Footprint of “Agility tyre jump”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

agility_balancin.descripcion: Long narrow plank tilting on a low pivot. One end touches the ground and the other is at knee height; step on it and it drops with a bang.
agility_balancin.imagen: Footprint of “Dog seesaw”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 3.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

agility_salto.descripcion: Light bar resting between two stands at shin or knee height. Touch it and it clatters to the ground.
agility_salto.imagen: Footprint of “Agility hurdle”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

agility_mesa.descripcion: Low square platform at shin height where the dog jumps on and waits. A trip hazard unless the cane finds it.
agility_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Agility pause table”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

mesa_picnic.descripcion: Plank table with a bench on each side, all in one piece. To sit you swing a leg over the bench; at the ends the top overhangs and the cane goes underneath.
mesa_picnic.imagen: Footprint of “Picnic table with attached benches”: three joined bands: a bench at the back, the table top in the middle and another bench at the front, 1.80 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

mesa_picnic_adaptada.descripcion: Picnic table whose benches are shorter than the top: at one end the top sticks out with no bench and clear space beneath for a wheelchair.
mesa_picnic_adaptada.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible picnic table with overhang”: two short benches and a table top that sticks out on the right, with no bench, for a wheelchair, 2.40 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

mesa_picnic_piedra.descripcion: Round stone table on a thick foot, ringed by curved backless stone benches. Cold and hard; a narrow gap between benches lets you in.
mesa_picnic_piedra.imagen: Footprint of “Round stone picnic table”: a circle, 2.20 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

banco_medio_tronco.descripcion: Half a log lying on two blocks, backless, bark side down. Low, rough and very heavy.
banco_medio_tronco.imagen: Footprint of “Half-log bench”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

deposito_cenizas.descripcion: Lidded sheet-metal drum beside the barbecues for the embers. It can stay hot on the outside for hours.
deposito_cenizas.imagen: Footprint of “Barbecue ash bin”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Dc”.

fuente_pilon.descripcion: Stone pillar with a spout pouring water non-stop into a long trough at knee height. You hear it from afar; the ground around is wet.
fuente_pilon.imagen: Footprint of “Spout fountain with trough”: a narrow pillar at the back (with the spout) and a wide trough at the front, 1.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Fp”.

pila_merendero.descripcion: Long concrete sink with two push taps, for washing up. Waist high; it drips and leaves puddles.
pila_merendero.imagen: Footprint of “Picnic area sink”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

refugio_merendero.descripcion: Roofed timber shelter, closed at the back and sides and open at the front, with a bench running inside. The sound changes inside: you sense the roof.
refugio_merendero.imagen: Footprint of “Picnic shelter”: a U open at the front, 4.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rm”.

papelera_madera_parque.descripcion: Slatted wooden litter bin with a metal bucket inside and a wide mouth, at hip height.
papelera_madera_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Wooden park litter bin”: an octagon, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

panel_ruta.descripcion: Large board between two wooden posts, with a small roof jutting out at head height. It shows the trail map, sometimes in relief.
panel_ruta.imagen: Footprint of “Trail information board”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

hito_km.descripcion: Dressed stone set at the edge of the path, knee high, with the kilometre number carved in: read it with your fingers.
hito_km.imagen: Footprint of “Distance marker stone”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Hk”.

pasarela_madera.descripcion: Plank path raised a hand's width above the ground, with handrails at the sides. Steps sound like hollow wood; the handrail guides you to the end.
pasarela_madera.imagen: Footprint of “Boardwalk with handrail”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

puente_madera_sendero.descripcion: Narrow plank bridge, slightly humped, with handrails. It rises as you step on and drops as you leave; you hear water below.
puente_madera_sendero.aviso: Timber bridge: it rises, then drops.
puente_madera_sendero.imagen: Footprint of “Timber footbridge”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

vado_piedras.descripcion: Row of flat stones for crossing the water one by one. They are a stride apart and wet: between stones your foot lands in water.
vado_piedras.aviso: Stepping stones: wet and spaced apart.
vado_piedras.imagen: Footprint of “Stepping stones ford”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.20 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

escalones_traviesas.descripcion: Sloping stretch of trail with steps made of timber sleepers backed with earth. Each step has a different rise and depth: feel for each one.
escalones_traviesas.imagen: Footprint of “Sleeper steps”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Et”.

tramo_grava.descripcion: Stretch of path covered in loose gravel. It does not block the way: it crunches underfoot and drags on the cane. It tells you that you are still on the path.
tramo_grava.imagen: Footprint of “Gravel stretch”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tg”.

portilla_ganado.descripcion: Board or tube gate closing the path to keep livestock in. Push to open and leave it shut; the fastening is usually a wire loop or a bolt.
portilla_ganado.imagen: Footprint of “Livestock gate”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pg”.

paso_canadiense.descripcion: Grid of iron tubes laid over a pit across the path. You walk on it, but there are gaps between tubes: a foot or the cane tip can slip through.
paso_canadiense.aviso: Cattle grid: gaps between the tubes.
paso_canadiense.imagen: Footprint of “Cattle grid”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

talanquera.descripcion: Fence of round posts with two timber rails at hip height along the trail edge. It marks the side of the drop or the river: trail it with your hand.
talanquera.imagen: Footprint of “Timber post-and-rail fence”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

barrera_forestal.descripcion: Horizontal iron tube closing the track to cars at hip height, supported only at its ends. The cane passes underneath without touching it and it catches you at the waist.
barrera_forestal.imagen: Footprint of “Single-bar forest barrier”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.85 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bf”.

muro_piedra_seca.descripcion: Wall of loose stones with no mortar, broad and of uneven height, between knee and chest. A good line to follow; the odd stone shifts when leant on.
muro_piedra_seca.imagen: Footprint of “Dry stone wall”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

mojon_piedra.descripcion: Cone-shaped pile of stacked stones, knee high, marking where the trail goes. Knock it and it collapses.
mojon_piedra.imagen: Footprint of “Stone cairn”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

flechas_sendero.descripcion: Thin post with arrow-shaped boards jutting sideways at face height. The cane, if anything, finds the post; the arrow tips give no warning.
flechas_sendero.imagen: Footprint of “Trail signpost with arrows”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Fs”.

raiz_camino.descripcion: Thick root surfacing and crossing the trail, hard and slippery. It does not block the way: it is a trip hazard at ankle height.
raiz_camino.aviso: Root on the path: lift your foot.
raiz_camino.imagen: Footprint of “Root across the path”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.50 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rc”.

tronco_caido.descripcion: Log lying right across the path at shin or knee height. Step over it or go round its end.
tronco_caido.imagen: Footprint of “Fallen log across the trail”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

rama_baja.descripcion: Thick branch crossing the path at forehead height. The cane will not find it: keep a hand in front of your face.
rama_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Low branch over the trail”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rb”.

barrizal.descripcion: Stretch of soft mud that never dries out. It does not block the way, but your foot sinks, squelches and slips.
barrizal.imagen: Footprint of “Muddy patch”: an irregular patch, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

zarzal.descripcion: Tangle of brambles with long stems reaching into the trail. They prick and snag clothes: the first thing you touch is a stray stem at arm height.
zarzal.imagen: Footprint of “Bramble thicket”: an irregular patch, 2.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Za”.

talud_tierra.descripcion: Short, steep earth slope at the side of the path. The cane runs up it; you cannot walk across.
talud_tierra.imagen: Footprint of “Earth bank”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 4.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

cuneta.descripcion: Narrow grassy ditch running alongside the path. It does not block the way, but the ground drops a hand's width at once: easy to twist an ankle.
cuneta.imagen: Footprint of “Path ditch”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cu”.

roca_redonda.descripcion: Rounded boulder, smooth and cold, chest high. You can trail your hand round it without meeting a corner.
roca_redonda.imagen: Footprint of “Large round boulder”: a circle, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rr”.

grupo_rocas.descripcion: Several rocks together at different heights, with edges and gaps between them. The outline goes in and out: do not trust it at speed.
grupo_rocas.imagen: Footprint of “Irregular rock cluster”: a jagged outline with nooks and bumps, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Gr”.

piedra_sentarse.descripcion: Stone with a flat top at knee height, worn smooth by sitters. It usually marks a junction or a resting spot.
piedra_sentarse.imagen: Footprint of “Sitting stone”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

barandilla_mirador.descripcion: Half-moon railing at the edge of the viewpoint, chest high. There is a drop behind it: this is the limit. A bench usually faces it and the wind blows harder.
barandilla_mirador.aviso: Viewpoint railing: there is a drop beyond.
barandilla_mirador.imagen: Footprint of “Curved viewpoint railing”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 5.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

mesa_orientacion.descripcion: Sloping half-moon stone lectern with the landscape in relief and the names of the hills in braille. Read it with both hands, left to right.
mesa_orientacion.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile orientation table”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

observatorio_aves.descripcion: Board hut with a long slot at eye level and a bench running inside. You enter by the open front; keep quiet inside: you hear the birds.
observatorio_aves.imagen: Footprint of “Bird hide”: a U open at the front, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Oa”.

estanque_parque.descripcion: Sheet of still water ringed by a stone kerb a hand's width high. No railing: beyond the kerb the ground ends and there is water. It smells damp and there are often ducks.
estanque_parque.aviso: Edge of the pond: stop, water ahead.
estanque_parque.imagen: Footprint of “Park pond with low edge”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 6.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

alberca_riego.descripcion: Open masonry tank with waist-high walls and water inside. Trail the wall with your hand; do not sit on the rim.
alberca_riego.imagen: Footprint of “Irrigation tank”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

chorros_suelo.descripcion: Circle of paving with flush nozzles that shoot water upwards, on and off. It does not block the way: you get wet and the ground is slippery.
chorros_suelo.aviso: Water jets: you will get wet.
chorros_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Walk-through ground jets”: a circle, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

arroyo.descripcion: Band of shallow water running between stones. You hear it from afar and it works as a guide: the sound comes from a line, not a point. The bank drops sharply and is slippery.
arroyo.aviso: Stream: the ground drops into water.
arroyo.imagen: Footprint of “Stream”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.50 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

cascada_pequena.descripcion: Water dropping over a step of rocks. It makes a loud, steady roar that masks other sounds; the rocks around are wet and it splashes.
cascada_pequena.imagen: Footprint of “Small waterfall”: a jagged outline with nooks and bumps, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

acequia.descripcion: Narrow, straight concrete channel with running water. It does not block the way, but it is a gap two hands deep: cross it in one stride or over a slab.
acequia.aviso: Irrigation channel: a gap with water. Cross it in one stride.
acequia.imagen: Footprint of “Irrigation channel”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

abrevadero.descripcion: Long stone trough at knee height, full of water, where livestock drink. A spout drips at one end.
abrevadero.imagen: Footprint of “Stone drinking trough”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

pozo_brocal.descripcion: Round stone parapet at waist height, with an iron arch above carrying the pulley and bucket. The mouth usually has a grille; your voice echoes inside.
pozo_brocal.imagen: Footprint of “Well with parapet”: an octagon, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

embarcadero.descripcion: Plank walkway running out over the water on piles, with no handrail. Steps sound hollow; there is water on both sides and at the end.
embarcadero.aviso: Jetty with no handrail: water at the sides and the end.
embarcadero.imagen: Footprint of “Wooden jetty”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

barca_varada.descripcion: Wooden boat pulled up on the shore, resting on its side. The bow is pointed and the gunwale is at knee height; inside are thwarts and oars.
barca_varada.imagen: Footprint of “Beached rowing boat”: a boat: square stern at the back and pointed bow at the front, 1.40 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

platano_sombra.descripcion: Large park tree with a thick trunk and smooth bark that peels off in thin, papery plates. The roots lift the ground around it and spiky balls fall in autumn; in the wind the large leaves rustle high above.
platano_sombra.imagen: Footprint of “London plane tree”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

pino_pinonero.descripcion: Straight trunk with thick, cracked bark in scales you can feel with your fingers; it is sticky with resin and smells of it. The umbrella crown is very high; the ground around is springy with dry needles and cones roll underfoot.
pino_pinonero.imagen: Footprint of “Stone pine”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

olivo.descripcion: Low, wide, twisted trunk full of hollows and knots big enough for a hand. The branches start low and the crown is at head height: approach with a hand in front. In autumn fallen olives stain and slip.
olivo.imagen: Footprint of “Olive tree”: a twisted trunk with several limbs and hollows, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ol”.

palmera.descripcion: Straight, branchless trunk covered in hard scales that scrape like a giant pine cone. The fronds are far above and rattle like dry paper in the wind; fallen dates squash and slip.
palmera.imagen: Footprint of “Date palm”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

sauce_lloron.descripcion: Long thin branches hanging from high up almost to the ground, like a round curtain. You part them with your hand and they do no harm; inside, sound is muffled and the trunk stands in the middle. There is usually water nearby.
sauce_lloron.imagen: Footprint of “Weeping willow curtain”: a round crown with a lobed edge, 8.00 by 8.00 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sl”.

arbol_frutal.descripcion: Small tree with a thin trunk, its crown at head height and the fruit hanging lower still. Depending on the season it smells of blossom or ripe fruit, and fallen fruit squashes underfoot.
arbol_frutal.imagen: Footprint of “Fruit tree”: a circle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Af”.

encina.descripcion: Broad tree with a short trunk and hard bark cracked into little squares. The crown is dense and casts deep shade; acorns and dry, slightly prickly leaves crunch beneath it. You hear birds inside.
encina.imagen: Footprint of “Holm oak”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

copa_baja.descripcion: Branches and leaves of a tree hanging down to forehead height. The cane passes underneath without touching anything: the first thing you feel is leaves on your face. Place it over a tree trunk.
copa_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Low tree crown”: a round crown with a lobed edge, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cb”.

arbol_joven_tutores.descripcion: Newly planted tree with a trunk as thin as a wrist, tied with rubber straps to three wooden stakes driven in around it. The stakes and low crossbars are what the cane finds; the bare earth around is slightly sunken.
arbol_joven_tutores.imagen: Footprint of “Young tree with stakes”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Aj”.

tocon.descripcion: What remains of a felled tree: a wooden cylinder at knee height, rough bark on the sides and a flat, ringed cut on top. Roots poke out around it and trip you.
tocon.imagen: Footprint of “Tree stump”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

tocones_equilibrio.descripcion: Winding row of log rounds set upright, each at a different height, for hopping from one to the next. There are stride-wide gaps between them: loose trip hazards at shin height.
tocones_equilibrio.imagen: Footprint of “Row of balancing stumps”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.50 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

pila_lena.descripcion: Cut logs stacked against a wall or between two posts, chest high. The face is uneven, with ends sticking out; it smells of wood and resin, and a loose log may roll when touched.
pila_lena.imagen: Footprint of “Woodpile”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

rama_desgajada.descripcion: Thick branch that fell from a tree in a storm: at one end it is a hard pole at shin height and at the other it opens into a tangle of twigs and leaves that snag.
rama_desgajada.imagen: Footprint of “Large broken-off branch”: a narrow trunk on the left ending in a wide crown of branches on the right, 4.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rd”.

bordura_boj.descripcion: Very low clipped hedge edging the flower beds and garden paths. Shin high, dense and firm, with a strong, distinctive smell. A good guide, but it trips anyone not expecting it.
bordura_boj.imagen: Footprint of “Box edging”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

laberinto_setos.descripcion: Wall of tall clipped hedge, higher than a person, with branches jutting forward to form dead-end corridors. Trail it with your hand; at a dead end, turn back.
laberinto_setos.imagen: Footprint of “Hedge maze section”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 6.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ls”.

seto_espino.descripcion: Unclipped field hedge of thorny shrubs tangled with old wire, separating two plots. It is uneven, prickly and snags clothing; you hear birds inside.
seto_espino.imagen: Footprint of “Hawthorn field hedge”: an irregular patch, 5.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

arbusto_redondo.descripcion: Dense, rounded bush, waist or chest high. The leaves give when touched, but the branches inside are firm; the cane slips in among them.
arbusto_redondo.imagen: Footprint of “Round shrub”: an irregular patch, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

rosaleda.descripcion: Group of waist-high rose bushes with thorny stems. They smell sweet when in bloom. Do not put your hand in carelessly: they prick.
rosaleda.imagen: Footprint of “Rose bed”: an irregular patch, 2.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ro”.

macizo_flores.descripcion: Bed of seasonal flowers in soft soil, edged with a low kerb. The flowers are below knee height: your foot is in the bed before you notice.
macizo_flores.imagen: Footprint of “Flower bed”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 2.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

lavanda_fila.descripcion: Row of knee-high lavender bushes with swaying spikes. Brushing them releases a strong scent that stays on your clothes; in summer bees hum among them.
lavanda_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Row of lavender”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Lf”.

cesped_pradera.descripcion: Expanse of short, soft grass. It does not block the way: footsteps go quiet and the cane brushes. Where the grass ends, the path begins.
cesped_pradera.imagen: Footprint of “Lawn”: a rectangle, 8.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

canaveral.descripcion: Thick clump of tall canes, taller than a person, by the water. The canes are hollow and thin; in the wind they knock together and the dry leaves whisper. The ground around is usually damp.
canaveral.imagen: Footprint of “Reed bed”: an irregular patch, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

chumbera.descripcion: Cactus of flat, fleshy pads stacked on each other, covered in fine spines that stick in at the slightest touch. Chest high and spreading sideways: give it a wide berth.
chumbera.aviso: Prickly pear: fine spines, do not touch.
chumbera.imagen: Footprint of “Prickly pear”: an irregular patch, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

emparrado.descripcion: Roof of wires and beams covered by a grapevine, on corner posts. Bunches of grapes hang down to forehead height; in summer it smells of grapes and wasps buzz; underneath is cool shade.
emparrado.imagen: Footprint of “Vine arbour”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, hanging 1.85 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Em”.

arco_rosales.descripcion: Iron arch over a path, covered in climbing roses. Its two feet stand either side of the way; above, thorny stems hang down to face height. Go through the middle with your head slightly bowed.
arco_rosales.imagen: Footprint of “Rose arch”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ar”.

celosia_enredadera.descripcion: Upright panel of criss-cross slats covered in jasmine or ivy. You can trail it with your hand like a soft wall; at night the jasmine smells strongly.
celosia_enredadera.imagen: Footprint of “Trellis with climber”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

surcos_huerto.descripcion: Tilled soil in parallel ridges with vegetables on top and a deep furrow between each, where the irrigation water runs. Your foot twists and sinks; walk along the trodden paths.
surcos_huerto.aviso: Furrows: the ground goes up and down.
surcos_huerto.imagen: Footprint of “Vegetable plot furrows”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sh”.

bancal_elevado.descripcion: Plank box full of soil at hip height, for growing without bending. The wooden rim makes a handrest; inside it smells of damp earth and tomato leaves.
bancal_elevado.imagen: Footprint of “Raised timber bed”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

mesa_cultivo.descripcion: Tray of soil on legs at table height, with clear space underneath for your legs or a wheelchair. The edge is rounded and you garden sitting down.
mesa_cultivo.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible growing table”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

tomateras_entutoradas.descripcion: Row of tomato plants tied to canes crossed like a roof. The cane tips poke out at the top at face height; the leaves smell strongly of tomato and stain your fingers.
tomateras_entutoradas.imagen: Footprint of “Staked tomato plants”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

espantapajaros.descripcion: Post driven into the plot with a crossbar at shoulder height, dressed in old clothes and a hat. The cane finds the post; the rag arms and hanging tins hit your face and clatter in the wind.
espantapajaros.imagen: Footprint of “Scarecrow”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

invernadero_tunel.descripcion: Tunnel of metal hoops covered in plastic sheeting, with a zipped or canvas door at one end. Outside, the plastic crackles and booms in the wind; inside it is warm and smells of damp and soil.
invernadero_tunel.imagen: Footprint of “Polytunnel”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 4.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “It”.

compostador.descripcion: Large bottomless plastic bin with a lid on top and a hatch at the bottom to take out compost. It smells of fermenting grass; inside it is warm and you may hear insects.
compostador.imagen: Footprint of “Compost bin”: an octagon, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

deposito_agua_huerto.descripcion: Thousand-litre cube-shaped plastic tank inside a cage of metal bars, on a pallet. There is a lever tap at the bottom; knocked, it sounds hollow or full depending on the water left.
deposito_agua_huerto.imagen: Footprint of “Caged water tank”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Da”.

cajonera_semillero.descripcion: Low wooden box with a sloping glass or plastic lid to protect seedlings. Knee high; the lid lifts up and is warm in the sun.
cajonera_semillero.imagen: Footprint of “Cold frame”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

armarios_aperos.descripcion: Row of narrow metal lockers, one per plot, each with its own padlock. They boom when shut and hold tools, boots and bags of fertiliser.
armarios_aperos.imagen: Footprint of “Allotment tool lockers”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

aspersor.descripcion: Circle of lawn watered by an impact sprinkler: in the middle, the metal head at ground level, a trip hazard; around it, the jet sweeps side to side with a tick, tick, tick and snaps back. You get wet and the grass is slippery.
aspersor.aviso: Sprinkler running: you will get wet.
aspersor.imagen: Footprint of “Running lawn sprinkler”: a circle, 8.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

riego_goteo.descripcion: Thin black tubes laid along the ground beside the plants, with a dripper every hand's width. They catch your foot, roll under the cane and the soil around is muddy.
riego_goteo.imagen: Footprint of “Drip irrigation lines”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rg”.

aperos_apoyados.descripcion: Hoe, spade, fork and rake stood up against the fence or shed. The wooden handles are smooth; the metal heads are on top, at chest and face height. Brush them and they slide and fall.
aperos_apoyados.imagen: Footprint of “Tools leaning on the fence”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

rastrillo_tumbado.descripcion: Rake left on the ground with its teeth upwards. Step on the tines and the handle flips up into your face. Find it with the cane and move it by the handle.
rastrillo_tumbado.aviso: Rake on the ground: do not step on the tines.
rastrillo_tumbado.imagen: Footprint of “Rake lying tines up”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Rt”.

regaderas_suelo.nombre: Watering cans and buckets on the path
regaderas_suelo.descripcion: Two or three watering cans and a bucket left in the middle of the plot path beside the tap. Low, plastic or zinc; they sound hollow or slosh if full.
regaderas_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Watering cans and buckets on the path”: an irregular patch, 0.80 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Rs”.

gallinero.descripcion: Wooden hen house with a mesh run in front. You hear clucking from afar and it smells of straw and feed. The run gate has a latch; inside, in the nest boxes, there are eggs.
gallinero.imagen: Footprint of “Hen house with run”: the hut at the back left and the wider mesh run in front, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ga”.

colmenas.descripcion: Row of wooden boxes on a low stand at the far end of the plot or out in the hills. You hear the hum before you arrive and it grows as you approach: do not touch them or stand in front of the entrance.
colmenas.imagen: Footprint of “Beehives”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

conejera.descripcion: Wood and mesh hutch on legs at waist height, with a sloping roof. Inside you hear the rabbits moving on the straw; the mesh at the front is fine and gives when touched.
conejera.imagen: Footprint of “Rabbit hutch on legs”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

cercado_ovejas.descripcion: Chest-high timber-railed pen with a few sheep or goats inside. You hear bleating and the clank of bells; it smells of wool and dung. Lean on it and one may come to sniff you.
cercado_ovejas.imagen: Footprint of “Sheep pen”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

hotel_insectos.descripcion: Wooden box with a little roof on a post at chest height, filled with hollow canes, cones and drilled logs. Explore it with your fingers: each hole is different. Small insects hum.
hotel_insectos.imagen: Footprint of “Bug hotel”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Hi”.

balancin_jardin.descripcion: Three-seat bench hung from a metal frame with a fabric canopy above. It rocks back and forth: the seat may swing towards you. The frame's legs splay at the sides.
balancin_jardin.imagen: Footprint of “Garden swing seat with canopy”: a rectangle, 2.10 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bj”.

banco_forja_jardin.descripcion: Bench with a wrought-iron back and arms and a seat of wooden slats. The arms have scrolls you can feel; the iron is cold in winter and hot in the summer sun.
banco_forja_jardin.imagen: Footprint of “Wrought-iron garden bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

hamaca_cuerda.descripcion: Net hammock strung between two trunks at hip height, swinging gently. The cane passes underneath without touching it; the ropes rising to the trees cross at chest height.
hamaca_cuerda.imagen: Footprint of “Rope hammock between trees”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 3.80 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Hc”.

reloj_sol.descripcion: Waist-high stone column with a bronze plate on top: the hour numbers are raised and a metal fin stands up in the middle. A good landmark in the middle of the garden.
reloj_sol.imagen: Footprint of “Sundial on a pedestal”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rs”.

bebedero_pajaros.descripcion: Shallow round basin on a stone foot at waist height, holding water. You hear birds splashing and they fly off as you approach.
bebedero_pajaros.imagen: Footprint of “Bird bath”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

sombrilla_playa.nombre: Beach umbrella stuck in the sand
sombrilla_playa.descripcion: Fabric beach umbrella with its pole stuck in the sand, often tilted. The cane finds the pole, but the edge of the canopy and the ribs are at face height; in the wind it flaps and may blow away.
sombrilla_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Beach umbrella stuck in the sand”: an octagon, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sp”.

hamacas_alquiler.nombre: Pair of rented loungers with parasol
hamacas_alquiler.descripcion: Two plastic sun loungers side by side with a fixed thatched parasol between them. They usually form rows: a narrow sand corridor separates one pair from the next.
hamacas_alquiler.imagen: Footprint of “Pair of rented loungers with parasol”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.20 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ha”.

paravientos_playa.descripcion: Strip of canvas stretched between several poles stuck in the sand, at waist height. It cuts the wind and you hear it snap; the poles poke up above.
paravientos_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Beach windbreak”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.00 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

sombrajo_fijo.nombre: Fixed shade of poles and thatch
sombrajo_fijo.descripcion: Thatched roof on four poles set in the sand, with a bench running underneath. The poles are all the cane finds; the roof is high enough and the sand beneath is cool.
sombrajo_fijo.imagen: Footprint of “Fixed shade of poles and thatch”: a hexagon, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sf”.

tienda_playa.descripcion: Small fabric tent, open at the front, with a canvas floor and stones or sand in the pockets to stop it blowing away. It is soft: the cane dents it; a baby may be sleeping inside.
tienda_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Pop-up beach tent”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 1.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

torre_socorrista_playa.descripcion: Wooden hut on tall legs with a steep ladder in front and a flagpole. From above you hear the whistle and the loudspeaker; underneath, between the legs, there is shade and rescue gear.
torre_socorrista_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Lifeguard tower”: a T shape, 2.00 by 2.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

mastil_bandera_playa.descripcion: Tall thin pole by the lifeguard post. The flag flying shows whether swimming is allowed; since you cannot see it, ask the lifeguard or listen to the announcements. You hear the cloth snapping and the halyard clinking.
mastil_bandera_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Sea-condition flagpole”: a circle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

ducha_lavapies.descripcion: Steel column with a push-button shower on top and a low tap for your feet, on a puddled wooden duckboard. The water is cold and you hear it fall; the duckboard is slippery.
ducha_lavapies.imagen: Footprint of “Beach shower and foot tap”: a narrow column at the back and the square duckboard in front, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Dl”.

pasarela_playa.descripcion: Path of slats tied together with rope, laid on the sand from the promenade to near the water, with no handrail. Footsteps sound wooden and wheelchairs roll easily; where it ends, your feet sink into soft sand.
pasarela_playa.aviso: End of the boardwalk: soft sand begins.
pasarela_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Roll-out boardwalk on the sand”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 15.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

silla_anfibia.descripcion: Plastic tube chair with large soft wheels that float, armrests and a push handle at the back. With it you go into the water with a helper; it waits parked at the end of the boardwalk.
silla_anfibia.imagen: Footprint of “Amphibious beach wheelchair”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

escalera_bajada_playa.descripcion: Concrete steps going down from the promenade to the sand, with a handrail on one side. The treads have sand on them and slip; the last one is higher because the sea washes the sand away.
escalera_bajada_playa.aviso: Steps down to the beach: the last step is higher.
escalera_bajada_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Steps down to the beach”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

castillo_arena.descripcion: Mound of damp, packed sand with towers at the corners and a moat around it full of water. It crumbles if you step on it; the moat is a small hole that twists your ankle.
castillo_arena.imagen: Footprint of “Sandcastle”: a square with a tower sticking out at each corner, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

hoyo_arena.descripcion: Hole dug by children, knee deep, with the dug-out sand heaped beside it. You do not notice it until your foot drops in; near the water it fills up by itself.
hoyo_arena.aviso: Hole in the sand: the ground drops.
hoyo_arena.imagen: Footprint of “Hole in the sand”: a circle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ha”.

toalla_bolsa.nombre: Spread towel with bag and flip-flops
toalla_bolsa.descripcion: Towel spread on the sand with a bag, flip-flops and sun cream on it. You can walk on the towel, but the bag and flip-flops trip you; someone is usually lying there.
toalla_bolsa.imagen: Footprint of “Spread towel with bag and flip-flops”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

nevera_playa.descripcion: Rigid plastic cool box with a handle, shin high. Cold inside; open it and the ice and cans rattle.
nevera_playa.imagen: Footprint of “Cool box”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Np”.

juguetes_arena.descripcion: Plastic toys scattered on the sand: a bucket, a spade, a rake and moulds. They are low and light; you tread on them and they crack or roll.
juguetes_arena.imagen: Footprint of “Beach bucket, spade and rake”: an irregular patch, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ja”.

piragua_varada.descripcion: Hard plastic kayak, long and narrow, pointed at both ends, lying on the sand with the paddle inside. It is low: a long trip hazard at shin height.
piragua_varada.imagen: Footprint of “Beached kayak”: a long spindle, pointed at both ends, 0.70 by 3.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

hidropedal.descripcion: Two long plastic floats joined by the seats and pedals, sometimes with a slide at the back. Beached at the water's edge, the floats are hollow and boom when struck.
hidropedal.imagen: Footprint of “Beached pedalo”: two long floats joined in the middle by the seat, 2.20 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Hi”.

velero_ligero.descripcion: Small sailing boat on a wheeled trolley with the mast up. The wires holding the mast run diagonally down to the sides, thin and taut: the cane misses them and they cross at face height.
velero_ligero.imagen: Footprint of “Dinghy on its launching trolley”: a boat: square stern at the back and pointed bow at the front, 1.60 by 4.20 metres, marked with the letters “Vl”.

tabla_paddle.descripcion: Long, wide, flat board, rounded at the front, lying on the sand with the paddle beside it. Almost flush with the ground: easy to tread on, and the paddle rolls.
tabla_paddle.imagen: Footprint of “Paddleboard lying on the sand”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.80 by 3.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

orilla_mar.descripcion: Strip of wet, firm sand where the waves come in. You hear them break ahead and feel cold water on your feet; the further you go, the deeper it gets. The waves push and pull.
orilla_mar.aviso: Water's edge: the water and waves begin.
orilla_mar.imagen: Footprint of “Water's edge”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 15.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Om”.

duna.descripcion: Mound of loose, fine sand, taller than a person, with tough, spiky marram grass. The ground rises and the sand gives at every step. It is protected: go round on the path.
duna.aviso: Dune: the ground rises and the sand gives.
duna.imagen: Footprint of “Sand dune”: an irregular patch, 10.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Du”.

captadores_dunas.descripcion: Low fence of stakes and canes tied with wire, running along the foot of the dunes to trap sand. Knee high, it gives a little and loose wires snag.
captadores_dunas.imagen: Footprint of “Sand-trap fencing”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

escollera.descripcion: Large stone blocks piled up running into the sea, with deep gaps between them and the lower part covered in slippery seaweed. The waves crash against them and gulls call.
escollera.aviso: Breakwater: loose rocks, gaps and slippery seaweed.
escollera.imagen: Footprint of “Rock breakwater”: a jagged outline with nooks and bumps, 5.00 by 15.00 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

posidonia_acumulada.nombre: Bank of dried seaweed on the shore
posidonia_acumulada.descripcion: Long heap of dried seaweed leaves piled up by the storm along the tide line. It is soft and springy, smells of salt and iodine, and may be wet and slippery underneath.
posidonia_acumulada.imagen: Footprint of “Bank of dried seaweed on the shore”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 6.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

charca_rocas.descripcion: Flat rock shelf at water level, full of pools with crabs and sea urchins. The rock is rough and sharp and very slippery where wet; you notice the pools by the sudden cold.
charca_rocas.aviso: Rocks with pools: slippery and sharp.
charca_rocas.imagen: Footprint of “Flat rocks with rock pools”: a jagged outline with nooks and bumps, 5.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.
